data.title: 五河琴里 · 晨光沙发珊瑚绒连帽衫的娇懒卷曲
data.description: 清晨阳光洒在客厅沙发上，琴里裹在宽大的粉红猫耳珊瑚绒长卫衣中，光洁小腿蜷缩在沙发上，揉着惺忪睡眼小口打着哈欠。
data.action: 双腿蜷在沙发垫上，两只手缩在长长的卫衣袖子口里揉眼睛，小嘴微张打哈欠
data.lighting: 温润初升朝阳照亮漂浮微尘，珊瑚绒面料泛着毛茸茸的高光
data.camera: 近景平视，极致展现娇憨依恋的私密生活感
data.promptProse: 1girl, solo, itsuka kotori, messy red hair, twin tails falling loosely, drowsy red eyes, oversized pink cat-eared coral fleece fluffy hoodie dress, hands tucked inside extra-long sleeves, rubbing sleepy eyes, yawning cutely, bare legs tucked up on soft living room sofa, warm morning sunbeams, cozy domestic morning intimacy.
data.animaCaption: 1girl, solo, itsuka kotori, red hair, oversized fluffy pink hoodie rubbing sleepy eyes on morning sofa.
